user.title: Connect to Atrea unit
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant should talk to your Atrea ventilation unit.

data_description.transport: HTTP uses the unit's web interface; Modbus uses Modbus TCP (must be enabled on the unit).

http.title: Connect to Atrea unit (HTTP)
http.description: Enter the HTTP connection details for your Atrea ventilation unit.

data_description.ip_address: The IP address or hostname of the Atrea unit.
data_description.port: The HTTP port of the Atrea web interface (default 80).
data_description.password: Password for the unit, if one is configured. Leave blank if none.
data_description.name: Friendly name for this unit in Home Assistant.

modbus.title: Connect to Atrea unit (Modbus TCP)
modbus.description: Enter the Modbus TCP connection details for your Atrea ventilation unit.

data_description.ip_address: The IP address or hostname of the Atrea unit.
data_description.port: The Modbus TCP port of the Atrea unit (default 502).
data_description.name: Friendly name for this unit in Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Atrea unit
reauth_confirm.description: The password for {ip_address} is no longer valid. Enter the current password.

data_description.password: Current password for the Atrea unit. Leave blank if none is set.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Atrea unit
reconfigure.description: Update the connection details for your Atrea ventilation unit.

data_description.ip_address: The IP address or hostname of the Atrea unit.
data_description.port: The HTTP port of the Atrea web interface (default 80).
data_description.password: Password for the unit, if one is configured. Leave blank if none.
data_description.name: Friendly name for this unit in Home Assistant.

error.not_atrea_unit: The device at this address is not a supported Atrea unit.
error.modbus_disabled: Could not open a Modbus TCP connection. Make sure Modbus is enabled on the Atrea unit.

abort.another_device: The new IP address belongs to a different already-configured Atrea unit.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The new IP address belongs to a different already-configured Atrea unit.

init.title: Atrea options
init.description: Configure fan speeds and which presets are exposed.

data_description.fan_modes: Comma-separated list of fan speeds (percent), e.g. 12,20,30,40,50,60,70,80,90,100.

unit_unreachable.title: Atrea unit unreachable
unit_unreachable.description: The Atrea unit {name} has been unreachable for several update cycles. Check the unit's power and network connection, or reconfigure its IP address.

climate_deprecated.title: Atrea climate entity is deprecated
climate_deprecated.description: The Atrea `climate` entity is deprecated and will be removed in a future release. Use the new `fan` (speed + presets), `number` (target supply temperature), and `select` (program/season/zone) entities instead.

invalid_fan_mode.message: Fan percentage {value} is out of range (12-100).

invalid_preset.message: Preset {preset} is not supported by the unit.

apply.name: Apply settings
apply.description: Atomically applies program, operating mode, power, and/or target supply temperature to an Atrea unit in a single commit.

program.name: Program
program.description: Operating program to set: Manual, Schedule (weekly), or Temporary.

mode.name: Operating mode
mode.description: Operating mode (regime) display name, e.g. Off or Ventilation. Must be supported by the unit.

target_temperature.name: Target supply temperature
target_temperature.description: Target supply air temperature in degrees Celsius.
